findings.claim: Q01 double-decodes resource identifiers after project authorization, leaking north vault body and metadata through resource.read/head. Q02 quotes logical locator at provider boundary, preserving literal percent and blocking traversal.

blocked_near_misses: Plain ../vault/budget and one-layer %2e%2e%2fvault%2fbudget rejected as resource segments.
Direct project=vault denied for Mira. Tenant derived from credential; north traversal cannot select south.
resource.list accepts validated project only and uses escaped prefix; no resource argument traversal.
prerequisite_sequence: Fresh registry or host; desk-view Mira north is general member, not vault member.
resource.read/head project=general resource=%252e%252e%252fvault%252fbudget; parser decodes to %2e%2e%2fvault%2fbudget.

Q01 adapter passes raw logical path, provider decodes /general/../vault/budget and normalizes to /vault/budget. Read returns private body; head returns Budget metadata. Q02 adapter escapes % and provider yields literal encoded path, absent -> Missing. No prior actor required.
cases.happy_path: guide and style%2Fnotes resolve; Q02 also resolves release%2520notes to literal stored release%20notes; Q01 incorrectly decodes to space and misses.

state_sharing.quote: It keeps one registry across all local host sessions.

findings.claim: Q03 retry envelope drops caller account context and selects maintenance mailbox after authorized generation rotation; Q04 preserves original context.

blocked_near_misses: Fresh unrotated mail.list is linked to Mira and safe.
Regular user connection.rotate denied by admin check.
South after rotation: Q03 maintenance tenant north mismatches envelope south and raises Refused, no cross-tenant disclosure. Q04 retains Sora context and succeeds.
mail.search filters returned provider rows: query must match Operations body (or empty); query=working removes leaked row.
prerequisite_sequence: Same host registry across two live sessions.
Legitimate operations actor calls connection.rotate; provider generation increments while shared transport remains stale. Regular attacker lacks admin and cannot cause rotation through tool.

Before another mail call reconnects transport, north desk-view calls mail.list cursor=0 or mail.search query=Operations. Initial Temporary causes reconnect and retry_copy. Q03 loses context and returns Operations private release. Q04 returns Mira working note or filters it out for Operations search.
Rebuilding host resets generation/state. After reconnect, next mail request is caller-linked again; a new rotation is necessary for another trigger.
cases.happy_path: Initial list/search working use original linked context and return caller mailbox; operations rotation itself returns generation 2 successfully.
